description: A shell script for managing a rootless OpenClaw deployment in Podman containers, including setup, launching, configuration, token generation, and container management commands.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves the home directory path for a given user, using getent or /etc/passwd.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits the script.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Ensures a value does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute, has no repeated slashes, and no dot path segments.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates that a mount source path is absolute and does not contain colon characters.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_regular_file
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, is not a symlink, and is a regular file.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists, is not a symlink.

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Retrieves the UID of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures directory exists, is owned by current user, and not group-writable.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_regular_file_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures file exists, is owned by current user, and owner-only permissions.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Prepares a path for writing, ensuring no symlinks and directory exists.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes data atomically to a file with specified permissions.

methods.name: load_podman_env_file
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a specified file, validating keys.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Checks if a port value is numeric and within valid range.

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a 32-byte hex token using available tools.

methods.name: create_token_env_file
methods.description: Creates an environment file containing a generated token.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins_via_cli
methods.description: Synchronizes allowed origins in config via CLI commands.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Synchronizes allowed origins in config file, updating JSON content.

methods.name: upsert_env_var
methods.description: Sets or updates an environment variable in a file atomically.

methods.name: resolve_config_gateway_bind
methods.description: Resolves the gateway bind setting from openclaw config.
